The mayor's order 3/2017 of 24.07.2017 (old.banm.sk/data/files/11694) sets 45 okrsky but lists only their polling stations; the 2017 street index page (bnm.sk/volby/201711/ABECEDA.UL/abeceda.htm, archived 2023) survives without its PDFs.

529371.name: Bratislava-Devínska Nová Ves
529371.note: The archived page 'Informácia pre voliča' of the 2017 regional elections (captured 2017-12-07) links 'Zoznam okrskov a ich ulíc na voľby do Bratislavského samosprávneho kraja' at /buxus/docs/Volbyvuc_2017/2017_volby_vuc2017_okrsky.PDF, but the file is gone from the website (404) and the Internet Archive has no capture of it; the elections page captures of July and September 2017 do not link it. No other copy found.

529419.name: Bratislava-Lamač
529419.note: The district's live archive ZIP of the 2017 regional elections (vuc-volby-2017.zip) holds candidate lists, results, objection office and phone notices but no okrsky document. The Internet Archive kept no 2017 capture of the old site's elections pages (lamac.sk volby.phtml, first captured 2018-05) and the PDFs it kept from 2017 (download_file_f.php ids 873936, 880541, 887529, 890000) are event posters. No document of 2017 found.

529427.name: Bratislava-Záhorská Bystrica
529427.note: The live site has no 2017 elections page. The Internet Archive kept the 2017 category page Voľby do orgánov sam. krajov 2017 (2017-08-22) linking only Informácie pre voliča, which it did not archive; no okrsky document of 2017 is in the CDX of zahorskabystrica.sk or old.zahorskabystrica.sk (only a 2013 and 2014 decision). The 2019 decisions list 4 okrsky by streets but are of a later vote.

542717.name: Bojná
542717.note: The website has election pages only for NR SR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024 and 2026; none holds an okrsky list for this vote (EP 2024 only says "2 volebné okrsky", one room in the Kultúrny dom). Fetched slowly because of HTTP 429 rate limits. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

542733.name: Bošany
542733.note: The website's elections section starts with NR SR 2020; no page or document for the 2017 vote. Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

542938.name: Horné Obdokovce
542938.note: In 2017 the municipality's website was the Drupal site now at archiv.hobdokovce.sk. Its 2017 regional-elections page and its notices (oznamy) of 2017 publish only the e-mail address for delegating OVK members and the information for voters; no document on the okrsky. The only okrsky document the website has (live and archived) is the mayor's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' of the elections of 29 October 2022 (download_file_f.php?id=1734793, posted 4.8.2022: okrsok 1 Bodok and Horné Obdokovce, okrsok 2 Obsolovce), which is another vote's document. The Internet Archive answered only intermittently (often 'Temporarily Offline' or connection refused) but its CDX lists were obtained; it holds no okrsky document of this vote. The live host rate-limited (HTTP 429) part of the time.

543004.name: Chynorany
543004.note: The archived elections page 'Voľby' (captured 2017-10-11) has the 2017 regional elections article (published 27.9.2017) with only the e-mail for delegating OVK members, the TSK obvod information and candidate lists; no utvorenie volebných okrskov. No 2017 notice-board capture between July and November 2017. The website www.chynorany.sk (Webygroup) keeps no election pages of earlier votes today (only 'Voľby 2026' for the October 2026 elections, with no okrsky document); its notice board and notice archive hold no okrsky document. The Internet Archive (CDX of chynorany.sk, all URLs 2017–2026) was searched for election pages, notice-board captures and the archived PDFs near each vote. Web search with the input queries found nothing either. The Internet Archive was reachable (its CDX API timed out at first, then answered).

543047.name: Klátova Nová Ves
543047.note: The website (úradné oznamy, 'Voľby 2026 - informácie', site search for okrsky/okrsok/volebné obvody/referendum) holds election notices of October 2026 only, plus old results (NR SR 2016, EP); no okrsky document of this vote. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

543187.name: Jaklovce
543187.note: The 2017 elections page holds only the results (Volby_KSK_2017.pdf); the old 2017 website (archived April 2017) and the CDX list no okrsky document of 2017.

543233.name: Kluknava
543233.note: The website's page for the 2017 vote (volby-2017) is empty: no documents. Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

543322.name: Margecany
543322.note: Margecany's okrsky decisions found (prezident 2024: 23.1.2024; referendum 2026: 24.4.2026) only create okrsky č. 1 and č. 2 and name their polling rooms (rooms 102 and 109 in the same obecný úrad building); they assign no streets, houses or parts to either okrsok, and the municipality has a single part, so no rules can be written or inferred. The live elections pages for 2017-2020 are empty and no other okrsky document of 2017-2026 is on the live site. The Internet Archive was offline (Temporarily Offline / empty CDX) throughout repeated retries over ~15 minutes, so archived pages could not be checked.

543331.name: Markušovce
543331.note: The website's elections section has pages only for NR SR 2020/2023, municipal 2018/2022, prezident 2024 and EP 2024; the regional-elections page has no files, and no 2017 okrsky document is on the site. The Internet Archive was unreachable when checked.

543373.name: Nálepkovo
543373.note: The website's okrsky notices (referendum 2023 of 10.11.2022, president 29.1.2024, EP 5.3.2024) only create two okrsky voting in one room (zasadacia miestnosť OcÚ) without saying which addresses vote in which; no rules can be written from them. The board and elections pages go back only to 2022. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

543519.name: Rudňany
543519.note: No document assigning houses to the two okrsky found. The municipality's okrsky decisions (rudnany.sk, Voľby: referendum 2023, NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024) only name the two polling stations (ZŠ s. č. 96; obecný úrad s. č. 234); the pages of 2018-2020 and of the referendum 2026 carry no okrsky notice. The municipality has no streets (houses by súpisné číslo in one part), so the split cannot be inferred.

543535.name: Slovinky
543535.note: The only okrsky decision found (EP 2024, 05.03.2024) names the two okrsky's polling rooms (Kultúrny dom Slovinky 58, Komunitné centrum Slovinky 379) without saying which houses vote where; the municipality is one part with no streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. Other votes' pages carry no okrsky document; the Internet Archive has no captures of obecslovinky.sk.

543578.name: Spišské Podhradie
543578.note: No okrsky document for the regional elections of 2017: the website's notice board and search have no 2017 election notice, and the Internet Archive's CDX of spisskepodhradie.sk has none.

543624.name: Spišský Štvrtok
543624.note: No okrsky notice of this vote found: the municipality's notice board (spisskystvrtok.sk) and the Internet Archive's index of the site have okrsky notices only from November 2022 on (referendum 2023, NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024, referendum 2026); the archived elections pages of 2019-2020 carry no okrsky document.

543772.name: Somotor
543772.note: No okrsky decision of this vote on the municipality's website: its document category for this vote (obecsomotor.sk/dokumenty, Voľby 2018 / Voľby do Európskeho parlamentu 2024) has notices, candidate lists and results but no okrsky decision.

543802.name: Streda nad Bodrogom
543802.note: The municipality's okrsky decisions (EP 2019, 22.02.2019; 2022; referendum 2023, 09.11.2022) only name the two okrsky's seats (Hlavná 390/176 or 391/174, and the cultural house Hlavná 217/127) without saying which streets or houses vote where; the okrsky cannot be drawn from them. Other votes' pages carry no okrsky document.

543951.name: Vojčice
543951.note: The live website (obecvojcice.sk) keeps only the 2026 election pages and a short notice board; neither has an okrsky announcement (the 2026 'Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania volieb' names only the polling station Kultúrny dom - svadobka and the okrsok number, no streets). Older pages are gone, and the Internet Archive stayed offline for this domain (CDX queries answered 'Temporarily Offline' / 504 on repeated attempts over about an hour), so no earlier document could be looked up. Web search found nothing.

544001.name: Zemplínska Nová Ves
544001.note: The 2017 regional elections: the municipality's website has no okrsky document for this vote. Its elections section (Voľby a referendá) starts with 2022 and the notice-board archive with 2021. The Internet Archive (reached after long outages) keeps the old site's 2019 elections page (-volby) with the presidential and EP 2019 files (call, voter information, candidates, poster places, a 'Voľby do Európskeho parlamentu 2019' PDF that is gone live and was not archived) and no okrsky document; it has no 2017 or 2020 okrsky file either. Later documents (2022–2024) make okrsok 1 the part Úpor and okrsok 2 the part Zemplínsky Klečenov.

544051.name: Vranov nad Topľou
544051.note: The vote pages under Úradná tabuľa » Voľby a referendá now hold only results; the announcements published before the vote (on the home-page election sections and news) were removed, and the Internet Archive keeps no okrsky document of this vote (its CDX of vranov.sk download.php files has only the NR SR 2023 okrsky announcement).

544094.name: Bystré
544094.note: Searched the municipality's website obecbystre.sk (elections page, aktuality all 35 pages, notice board, archives) and its predecessor bystre.ocu.sk, live and in the Internet Archive (CDX of both domains; downloaded and viewed every archived/live file of the election period). No 2017 okrsky document was found: the 2017 site bystre.ocu.sk has archived only the 'Informácie pre voliča' (article --3-261, file scan0921, July 2017) and the OVK e-mail notice (--3-277); the okrsky notice itself was not archived and is not live. Moreover, every okrsky notice Bystré has published (2023–2026) names only the two polling stations (Obecný úrad, Šarišská 98/20; Komunitné centrum, Hamzova 630/2A or Kultúrny dom, Poštová 306/8), no streets; with a single part (Bystré) and both stations in it, such a document could not give rules either. The Internet Archive was slow/intermittent but answered after retries.

544116.name: Čaklov
544116.note: The elections page keeps only commission minutes (NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024, referendum 2026); the notice board's only okrsky notice ('Oznámenie o vytvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností', detail=74892) is of the 2026 municipal elections. No okrsky document of this vote; the Internet Archive was offline ('Temporarily Offline') during the search.

544213.name: Hanušovce nad Topľou
544213.note: The city's current website lists election sections only from the 2020 National Council election on; no okrsky document of this vote is on the live website. The Internet Archive stayed offline ('Temporarily Offline' / no answer) across repeated retries over more than 15 minutes, so the city's former website (e_download.php files) could not be checked in the archive.

545589.name: Cabaj-Čápor
545589.note: The archived notices page of 2017-09-17 links "Určenie volebných okrskov 2017.pdf" (download_file_f.php?id=857447), but the file is gone from the website (404) and the Internet Archive never captured it. No other copy found.

545651.name: Veľké Držkovce
545651.note: The website (new CMS since 2023) keeps no okrsky document of this vote and the Internet Archive has no capture of one (its captures of the domain begin in 2020 and hold only 2023 referendum, 2024 presidential and 2026 municipal okrsky notices). The 2024 and 2026 notices make each part of the municipality one okrsok (1 Čuklasovce, 2 Horné Držkovce, 3 Dolné Držkovce), but no document of this vote was found.

545741.name: Trenčianske Stankovce
545741.note: The current website's elections pages cover only 2022-2026; the notice board's archive records (searched for okrsk, volebn, voľb, miestnost, utvoren and listed in full) have for this vote only other election notices (vyhlásenie, informácie pre voliča, delegovanie, výsledky), no okrsky document; the Internet Archive holds no elections page or okrsky document of the domain from 2017.

546640.name: Dolný Lieskov
546640.note: The website's elections documents (Dokumenty – Voľby) hold okrsky documents for the NR SR 2023, EP 2024 and 2026 votes only; none for the regional elections of 2017. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

555576.name: Trhová Hradská
555576.note: The municipality's website (live and as archived since 2017) publishes for the votes only commission minutes, delegation addresses and voter information; no document creating the okrsky (utvorenie volebných okrskov / zoznam ulíc) for any vote 2017–2026 was found; a web search found none either.

555754.name: Matúškovo
555754.note: Matúškovo's okrsky documents (2023 NR SR 'Zverejnenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností' of 27.06.2023, and the same for 2024 and 2026) give each okrsok only its polling station, both in the same building (Centrum voľného času, Matúškovo č. 513: okrsok 1 predsieň, okrsok 2 zasadačka); the municipality has one part and no streets in the register, so no rules can be derived from them (prompt: stations only and not one per part -> not_found). No document assigning streets or house numbers to the okrsky was found on the website, live or in the Internet Archive's CDX of matuskovo.sk 2017-2026.

556157.name: Jacovce
556157.note: The 2017 elections page was archived only on 2017-07-21, linking just the vyhlásenie and informácia pre voliča (docs/volby2017/); no okrsky document of 2017 is archived and the old site's files are gone (new webygroup site, old /docs/ paths answer 404).

556483.name: Križovany nad Dudváhom
556483.note: The archived 2017 elections page (old WordPress site, captured 2017-11-26) links only the decision on the elections, voter information, e-mail address, candidate lists, the portable ballot box notice and results; no okrsky document. The archived scans posted on the notice board in July–September 2017 (wp-content/uploads/2017/07–09) were OCR-checked: all contracts. The current site has no 2017 documents.

557293.name: Vlkanová
557293.note: The 2017 elections page (archived 2017-11-13) links only 'volby info.pdf' (download_file_f.php?id=865196) and voter information; that PDF was never archived and the old site is gone (404). No okrsky document of 2017 found.

557358.name: Vrútky
557358.note: No okrsky document of this vote found: the town's current website (vrutky.sk) keeps vote pages only from the 2022 elections on, and the Internet Archive's sparse captures of the old site (2016-2021, textsvk/ and download/ files) hold only 2018 election results, no okrsky notice.

558320.name: Ivanka pri Nitre
558320.note: No 2017 elections document: the old site (ivankaprinitre.sk/www/) as archived 2017–2018 holds no elections page or okrsky file; the archive lists no such PDF. The only okrsky documents on ivankaprinitre.sk are of 2022-11 (referendum 2023), 2023-06 (NR SR 2023), 2024-01 (president 2024), 2024-03 (EP 2024), giving only the three polling stations (all in the Kultúrny dom), and 2026-07 (municipal/regional 2026-10-24, with streets). Internet Archive was reachable.

559784.name: Turňa nad Bodvou
559784.note: No okrsky decision for this vote on the website's notice board (which keeps the 2022, 2022-11 referendum, 2024 presidential and 2026 decisions) or in the Internet Archive: the archived 2018–2020 election pages list only voter information and candidate lists (their 2018 'oznam' PDFs are 404 and not archived), and no decision for 2017, 2019, 2023-09, 2024-06 or the 2026 referendum is published.

560103.name: Vysoké Tatry
560103.note: The town's notice board keeps only current items (the October 2026 elections and the July 2026 referendum's minutes, no okrsky announcement); earlier announcements were removed and survive only in the Internet Archive, which was offline (the 2022 documents in this repository come from it). The host rate-limits requests (HTTP 429), so fetching was kept minimal.

560154.name: Smižany
560154.note: No okrsky document of 2017 (no page for that vote) on the website; Internet Archive offline; the host rate-limits requests.

580317.name: Utekáč
580317.note: The 2017 elections page lists no okrsky document (only candidate lists, delegation notices, information for voters). The Internet Archive (offline at first, reachable later) holds for obecutekac.sk in 2017 only captures of older election pages (NR SR 2016, municipal 2014) and no okrsky document. Later votes' 'Oznamenie_okrsky.pdf' names only the 2 polling stations (Utekáč 848; Drahová 1051), no streets.

580554.name: Čenkovce
580554.note: The website's elections page lists only the 2026 referendum article, whose files (results, information for voters, decision on the referendum) include no okrsky document; older votes are not on the current site. The site then refused our connections (blocked) and the Internet Archive refused connections too, so the notice board and older captures could not be checked; the maintainer may retry.

580899.name: Lužianky
580899.note: The obec's current site (moderneobce, since 2019) keeps for the regional elections of 2017 only the results (article 'Voľby do orgánov samosprávnych krajov 2017', posted 5.11.2017, with the two okrsky's zápisnice). The 2017 site (Joomla, luzianky.sk/uradna-tabua) is barely in the Internet Archive: no capture between January 2017 and May 2018 of its notice board or elections pages, and no okrsky document of 2017 in the CDX listing of the domain. Later okrsky documents (2023, 2024) exist but may not stand in for 2017.

581020.name: Hrnčiarovce nad Parnou
581020.note: No okrsky document for the regional elections of 4 November 2017 was found on hrnciarovce.sk, live or in the Internet Archive (its 2017 captures of the old site hold no elections page or okrsky file); the municipality has one part and its later decisions (2022-2026) only name one polling station, Kultúrny dom, Farská 37, for every okrsok, without streets.

581399.name: Banka
581399.note: The notice board (current and archive) and the site search find okrsky documents only for the 2022 elections and the 2023 referendum; no okrsky document of the regional elections of 2017 found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

582093.name: Vyšný Medzev
582093.note: The website's elections pages start with 2018; the Internet Archive's only 2017 capture of the notice board (February 2017) predates the 2017 regional elections and no 2017 okrsky document is archived.

582816.name: Žitavany
582816.note: The live website (www.zitavany.sk, Voľby - Referendum) keeps vote pages only from the 2022 elections on; the oldest okrsky document there is the referendum's of 2023. In the Internet Archive (CDX of zitavany.sk 2017–2022 and of the old notice board) no okrsky document of 2017–2020 is captured: the 'Voľby VÚC 2017' page is captured empty (2018-12-30, 2021-05-06); the 2018 notice-board entry 'Voľby do orgánov samosprávy obcí 2018' links only the voters' information and the decision calling the elections; the 2018 obvody notice concerns council obvody only; the 2019 notice board lists EP 2019 voter-information and voting-certificate entries, never captured, and no okrsky entry; the 2020 by-election page links only the obvody/seats decision and results. Web search found nothing else. The Archive was intermittently offline but answered after retries.

598151.name: Košice-Sever
598151.note: The 2017 elections category page (archived 2017-09-18) links the article 'Oznámenie o volebných okrskoch a volebných miestnostiach v MČ Košice – Sever pre voľby do orgánov…', but the Internet Archive has no capture of that article nor of any okrsky PDF of 2017; the live site (new CMS) keeps nothing older than 2023. Earliest okrsky document found: 28.01.2019.

598186.name: Košice-Staré Mesto
598186.note: The district's elections page and site search hold documents from 2024 on only (presidential and EP elections 2024, referendum and elections 2026); nothing of this vote. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

598682.name: Košice-Dargovských hrdinov
598682.note: No okrsky document of 2017 on the website (elections page starts in late 2019); Internet Archive offline.

599093.name: Košice-Barca
599093.note: The old site's page 'Voľby do VÚC 2017' (archived 2017-09-15) links 'Určenie volebných okrskov a miestností' (/images/subory/ine/vol .okrsky.pdf), but the Internet Archive never captured that PDF (404) and it is gone from the live site.

599794.name: Košice-Krásna
599794.note: The website's elections page starts with the 2022 elections and the old notice board (to 8/2021) holds nothing on elections; no okrsky document of the regional elections of 4 November 2017 found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

599816.name: Košice-Nad jazerom
599816.note: No okrsky or obvody document of this vote on jazerokosice.sk: the Internet Archive (CDX of the whole domain 2017-2025) holds okrsky lists only for 2019 (presidential), 2022, the 2023 referendum, 2023, and 2024; the live site (rebuilt 2025) and CUET have none.

599824.name: Košice-Juh
599824.note: The district's elections page linked an okrsky document for several votes (e.g. download/33319 for the referendum 2023, download/35781 for the NR SR election 2023, download/37199 for 2024), but the website has deleted them ("Download does not exist") and the Internet Archive kept none of them; for 2017–2020 the archived elections pages link no okrsky document. Only the 2026 documents remain online.

599883.name: Košice-Sídlisko KVP
599883.note: The old website's page for the regional elections of 2017 ('Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností', archived) links the mayor's PDF, but the PDF is gone live (404), was not captured by the Internet Archive, and the page itself has no text of the okrsky. The website's archive (archiv.mckvp.sk) answers 503.

599972.name: Košice-Luník IX
599972.note: The live website www.mclunik9.sk refused connections on 2026-10-31. In the Internet Archive, the old site's notice board (uradna_elektronicka_tabula, captured 2019-07-16, listing every item from 2015 to 26.3.2019) and the WordPress board that replaced it in 2020 (oznamenia, captured 2020-10-28; elections page dokumenty/volby empty) list no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' for any vote before 2022: for the regional elections of 2017 they post only the list of registered candidates for the KSK elections (9.10.2017). The archive's list of the domain's PDFs has no okrsky document before the 2022 one (Utvorenie-volebnych-okrskov-a-urcenie-volebnej-miestnosti-v-MC-KE-LIX.pdf, dated 3.8.2022), which may not be used for this vote.
